phase: Phase 4b: The live runs and the first track A results (by Sun 2026-11-22)
summary: Pass at HEAD c0e8db5 with no blocking finding. I found no real key in a committed file or a public page. The credential controls hold on every printed path: the seed reason, the failed-scan text, the E1 event join, the 499-byte cut, and the closed quota list. Ten test files pass one at a time. The E1 case runs and passes. Two new runner aborts and the judge parity gap are nonblocking under the PM round cap and go to Green.
nonblocking_findings: N26/G1 [Major, nonblocking] The 500-byte cut aborts the run on a long line. `review-run.sh:959` and `judge-run.sh:724` run `printf '%s' "$line" | head -c 499` under `set -euo pipefail` (`review-run.sh:96`, `judge-run.sh:75`). `head` exits after 499 bytes, `printf` gets SIGPIPE, and the pipeline returns 141. The runner exits 141 with no line and no record. My run of the extracted `error_line_of` with a 307200-byte stderr line gave exit 141 and no output. The N26 case (`review-run.test.ts:4391`) runs the function under plain `bash -c`, so it passes. The case also stubs `scan_output` and writes no record (Review A F4). Fix: use `${line:0:499}` or a pipefail exception for this line. Route to Green.

N13 [Minor, nonblocking] The judge takes a forged result branch that comes last. `judge-run.sh:1136` pushes result text into `parts` before the filter. My extracted run gave `{"g1":"false-claim"}` for a good text event then a forged result event. `review-score.ts:261` and `adjudicate.ts:250` keep result text apart and keep `real-defect`. The new case (`decode-parity.test.ts:628`) puts the forged result first, so it passes under this defect. Fix: keep result parts apart in the judge. This is also Review A F2.

N27 [Nit, nonblocking] The new sum check works, and the committed case does not exercise it. `review-run.test.ts:4431` sets two fields to 1e16. `isToken` rejects each field before the sum (`review-run.sh:156`), so the flag clears without the new check. Two fields of 2^53-1 clear the flag through the sum: my run gave `18014398509481982 2 0 0 0 0`. A cut final `step_finish` keeps the flag 1 (my run), as Review A F8 found. Fix: use two safe fields; clear the flag for a cut tail.

N10/G2 [Nit, nonblocking] The new symlink walk can abort the run. `review-run.sh:797` and `judge-run.sh:561` run `find ... | head -n 1` under `set -euo pipefail`. A tree with many links returns 141 before the refusal (my run on `/usr/lib` gave 141). A fresh job tree is empty, so the trigger is a preset `BENCH_OPENCODE_HOME`. The refusal also says the link leaves the root, but the guard refuses any link (Review A F5). Fix: add `-quit`; name the exact condition.

N15 [Nit, nonblocking] The orphan scans are still not scoped to the file's own roots. `review-run.test.ts:343` and `judge-run.test.ts:316` filter by `mg-`, the suite prefix. Another session's `mg-` fake still fails the file.

N29 [Nit, nonblocking] The values file keeps a predictable path under the ambient TMPDIR (`review-run.sh:645`, `judge-run.sh:303`). The `: > "$TMP_VALUES"` open follows a planted symlink, and mode 600 does not stop it. A SIGKILL leaves the file. Fix: create it with `mktemp`, or pass the values through a process substitution.
N5 [Nit, carried] The seed cwd check trusts the exit status of `git rev-parse` (`provider-credential.sh:186-191`). No test covers it. Section 14.5 records it as document only.
N12 [Nit, carried] The fence regex cost stays bounded by the call output cap (`judge-run.sh:1155`). Section 14.5 records it as document only.

N20 [Nit, carried] `error_event_text` reads `error.message`, `error.data.message`, and a string `error`. Only a live Go region error shows the real text. The live check is pending in `probe-4.10.txt`.
N24 [Nit, carried] The scan matches a whole value only. A value split over two lines leaks a prefix, now cut at 499 bytes. Section 14.5 records the limit as document only.

Seed reason [Nit, nonblocking] The runner echoes the helper's text after the prefix (`review-run.sh:809-812`, `judge-run.sh:572-575`). The no-entry pattern has no end anchor, so a trailing value in that helper line would print. The helper also calls a no-value entry 'no active entry' (`provider-credential.sh:246`). Fix: print a fixed text from a closed list; name the no-value state. The judge case is missing (Review A F9).

Quota text [Nit, nonblocking] The stopped reason doubles its prefix. `quota.ts:144` writes `quota: <reason>` to stderr. The runner stores `quota: $QUOTA_REASON` (`review-run.sh:753`, `judge-run.sh:1030`), so the record says `quota: quota: ...`. Fix: strip the prefix.

Marker test [Nit, nonblocking] The foreign-marker cases do not isolate the marker. The foreign entry also has its own HOME and cwd (`judge-run.test.ts:3277`, `adversarial-p4-runner.test.ts:983`). Removing the marker filter keeps them green (Review A F7).

Docs [Nit, nonblocking] The pilot text still names `opencode/hy4-flash-free` (`plan.md:2534`, `plan.md:2554`, `spec.md:573`, `spec.md:631`, `spec.md:784`). `routes.json:25` holds `opencode-go/hy4-flash-free#high`, so a manual run refuses (Review A F10).

TERM race [Nit, nonblocking] `stop_daemons` sends TERM to the collected pids with no start-time check (`review-run.sh:536`). A reused pid in that window gets TERM. The start-time guard covers KILL and the log only.
evidence: Provenance: `git rev-parse HEAD` returned c0e8db545caeeea99bfe1a61eeafff8be59c99b5 at the start and at the end. The brief names c0e8db5 as role_base_sha and 7d7d218 as phase_base_sha. The audited HEAD is current. The work tree held four untracked paths at the start and at the end: `.opencode/`, `harness/model-guide/data/sets/`, `harness/wt.txt`, `tech-debt.md`.

Security applicability: applicable. `git diff --stat 7d7d218..HEAD` names 15 files. The production files are `review-run.sh`, `judge-run.sh`, `provider-credential.sh`, `quota.ts`, `review-score.ts`, `adjudicate.ts`, and `routes.json`. They print and store the error line of a failed model call and the seed refusal line.

A2 not applicable: `git diff 7d7d218..HEAD | grep -cE '(published|publish|draft|consent|anonymi)'` returns 1, and the match is the plan heading `## Phase 5: The publish gate`. `git diff --stat 7d7d218..HEAD -- harness/model-guide/publish.ts` is empty. No test in the range flips a draft to published.
A6 not applicable: `git diff --stat 7d7d218..HEAD -- measure/tracks.md` is empty. `grep -ci resolved measure/tracks.md` returns 0. The registry makes no security-resolved claim for this phase.

Secret grep: `git log -p 7d7d218..HEAD | grep -cE 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}'` returns 0, and the AKIA, ghp_, and PRIVATE KEY patterns return no hit. The only key-like string under `measure/runs/model_guide/` is the fake test value `sk-test-credential-value-0123456789`, quoted by review records and `red-4.15.txt:50`. `measure/runs/` is gitignored, so no commit holds them.

Seed export: `provider-credential.sh:193-194` runs `timeout 60 ... auth export "$PROVIDER" --standalone` in a `mktemp -d` folder outside every git work tree. Its stdout is captured in `out` and never printed (`:205`). Its stderr goes to the mode-600 `ERR_FILE` under the job tmp, which the trap removes. The helper refuses with fixed text only (`:239-249`). The empty and foreign cases make one export call (SR1, SR2); the no-value text also stops after one call in the code.

Seed capture: `review-run.sh:807` and `judge-run.sh:570` capture stderr only (`2>&1 > /dev/null`). The case prints only the two fixed prefixes, else the bare refusal. The seed payload never reaches stdout, a record, or a file. SR1, SR2, and R-SR1 pass (credential-provider 24, review-run 97).

Credential paths: all error lines pass `error_line_of` (`review-run.sh:1095`, `:1099`, `:1198`; `judge-run.sh:813`, `:1068`). The failed-scan text is a constant (`review-run.sh:874`). The E1 join scans `error_all_events_text` and prints the fixed text only (`review-run.sh:981-986`). A grep for a direct read of the error files finds only the quota stderr read (`review-run.sh:685`, `judge-run.sh:515`), which `quota.ts:137-145` fills with closed-list text.

Daemon guard: the `daemon_pids` and `error_line_of` texts are byte-identical in both runners (`diff` of the extracted functions returned 0). The marker check is `if (job !== "" && real(job) !== baseReal) continue;`. `real("")` returns `""`, so a process with an unreadable environ and cwd never matches the HOME and cwd fallback. The guard does not signal a process of another run.

G1 proof: `bash -c` with `set -euo pipefail` and the extracted `error_line_of` from `review-run.sh:943-993`, a 307200-byte stderr line, and stub `scan_output` gave exit 141 and no output. A 200000-byte `printf | head -c 499` pipeline returned 141. The same pipeline in the N26 case runs without `set -e`, so it passes.
G2 proof: `bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; x="$(find /usr/lib -type l -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)"; echo after'` printed no `after` and exited 141.

N13 proof: the extracted judge verdict decoder (`judge-run.sh:1120-1170`) read a good text event then a forged result event and wrote `{"g1":"false-claim"}`. The reverse order wrote `{"g1":"real-defect"}`. `review-score.ts:263` and `adjudicate.ts:252` ignore result text when text parts exist.

N27 proof: the extracted `read_tokens` (`review-run.sh:150-197`) gave flag 1 for a valid `step_finish` then a cut `step_finish`. It gave `18014398509481982 2 0 0 0 0` for two events with input 2^53-1. The committed case uses 1e16, which `isToken` rejects before the sum.

Test runs, one file at a time. Bun: `review-run.test.ts` 97 pass, `decode-parity.test.ts` 4 pass. Vitest: `judge-run` 50, `quota` 31, `credential-provider` 24, `adversarial-p4-runner` 16, `adversarial-p4b` 12, `adversarial-p4c` 13, `review-score` 27, `adjudicate` 23, all pass. The focused E1 run shows a check mark and no skip.

Gates: `bash -n` passes on both runners and the helper. `git status --short docs/` prints nothing. The frozen-path diff of `harness/opencode-credential.sh`, `harness/opencode-host.sh`, `harness/provenance.ts`, and `harness/tests` is empty. `pgrep -af 'fake-opencod[e]|quota-serve[r]'` printed nothing of mine at the end.

test_strategy_violations: A4: the N27 case does not fail when the new sum check is removed, because `isToken` rejects 1e16 before the sum.
The N26 case runs `error_line_of` without the runner's `set -euo pipefail`, so it does not see the exit 141 abort.
The P4 N13 case puts the forged result first, so the judge divergence does not fail it.
live_contract_violations: Section 14.5 N26 says a 300 KB line gives a record and exit 0. The live runner exits 141.
route_parity_violations: The judge decoder differs from `review-score.ts` and `adjudicate.ts` for a top-level result event after the text answer.
security_applicability: applicable: the range changes the credential helper and both runners that print and store the error line of a failed model call, the seed refusal line, and the quota reason line

ratings.evidence: The credential paths hold, but a 300 KB error line aborts the runner with exit 141 (`review-run.sh:959`), and the judge takes a forged result that comes last (`judge-run.sh:1136`).

Ten files pass, but the N26 case omits `set -euo pipefail` (`review-run.test.ts:4391`), the N27 fixture is rejected before the sum (`:4431`), and the N13 case is order-blind (`decode-parity.test.ts:628`).
`git diff --stat 7d7d218..HEAD` names 15 planned files and no frozen path; the symlink guard refuses more than its stated contract (`review-run.sh:800`).
Every claim in this record has a command result or a file:line, including the two exit 141 reproductions and the forged-last decoder run.
